title: Running Median of Range Readings (two heaps)
hints: Keep the lower half in a max-heap and the upper half in a min-heap: `std::priority_queue<double, std::vector<double>, std::greater<double>>`.
Invariant: `lo.size() == hi.size()` or `lo.size() == hi.size() + 1`, and `lo.top() <= hi.top()`.
add(x): push into `lo` if it is empty or `x <= lo.top()`, else into `hi`. Then rebalance by moving one top across if the sizes break the invariant.
median: odd count gives `lo.top()`, even count gives `(lo.top() + hi.top()) / 2`, empty gives NaN.
